$comment: Third-party hosts that may appear literally in compose files, workflows, Dockerfiles and .env.example templates. Every entry needs a reason. Hosts on our own domains are never allowed here — read them from deploy/domains.env (generated from packages/shared-types/src/platform-domains.json). Loopback, single-label service DNS, .internal/.local/.test suffixes and RFC example.* domains are ignored by the checker and must not be listed.
